newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,277 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,277 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,277 contracts compared with 880 overnight Thursday.
There were 200 wheat, 895 corn, 1,104 soybean, seven soymeal, 31 soyoil, 24 corn calls, four corn puts, 10 soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 to 3-1/2 cents lower, corn was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were 3-1/2 cents lower to 2-1/4 higher.
